@ChristosArgyrop@mast.hpc.social
Saying it another way:
As often happens w/ LLM-gen-AI: I have to constantly make my own edits to generated #Perl code to fix obvious bad style & bad coding habits in LLM-gen-AI-generated code. 

My theory is that because Perl::Critic was hyped heavily on various respected Perl fora (for good reason, of course), the #LLMGenAI is over-trained toward the outcome that Perl::Critic is magic that finds every style/bad coding issue possible.
Cc: @jgamble@fosstodon.org @brennen@federation.p1k3.com
